quests.instruction: Touch the body part we use to give a warm, big hug!
quests.question: Arms
quests.hint: You have two, and you hug people with them!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Arms help you hug, wave, and carry things!
quests.funFact: You use over thirty muscles just to bend and lift your arms!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part we use to point at a pretty rainbow!
quests.question: Fingers
quests.hint: You have five on each hand!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Fingers help you point, count, and pick up small things!
quests.funFact: You have ten fingers, and each one has its own fingerprint!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part we use to hear birds singing!
quests.question: Ears
quests.hint: You have two, one on each side of your head!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Ears help you hear sounds like music and voices!
quests.funFact: Your ears never stop listening, even while you sleep!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part we use to taste yummy strawberries!
quests.question: Tongue
quests.hint: It helps you taste sweet, sour, and salty foods!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Tongue helps you taste your food and speak clearly!
quests.funFact: Your tongue has thousands of tiny taste buds on it!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you shrug when you are not sure of the answer!
quests.question: Shoulders
quests.hint: Your backpack straps rest right on these!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Shoulders are where your arms connect to your body, and help you shrug and lift!
quests.funFact: Your shoulders let your arms swing all the way around!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part we use to smell fresh cookies baking!
quests.question: Nose
quests.hint: It sits right in the middle of your face!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Nose helps you smell and breathe in fresh air!
quests.funFact: Your nose can remember thousands of different smells!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part we use to clap and hold our toys!
quests.question: Hands
quests.hint: You clap these together to cheer!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Hands help you hold, clap, and catch things!
quests.funFact: Each of your hands has twenty seven tiny bones inside!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part we use to chew crunchy apples!
quests.question: Teeth
quests.hint: You brush these with a toothbrush!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Teeth help you bite and chew your food!
quests.funFact: Children have twenty first teeth before their grown-up teeth arrive!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part we use to wiggle inside our socks!
quests.question: Toes
quests.hint: You have ten, and they wiggle inside your shoes!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Toes help you balance and push off the ground when you walk!
quests.funFact: You have ten toes, just like you have ten fingers!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part we use to see colorful rainbows!
quests.question: Eyes
quests.hint: You have two, and you blink them!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Eyes help you see everything around you, like colors and shapes!
quests.funFact: Your eyes can notice millions of different colors!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that connects your head to your shoulders!
quests.question: Neck
quests.hint: It is between your head and your shoulders!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Neck connects your head to your shoulders and lets your head turn!
quests.funFact: Your neck lets your head turn almost all the way around!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part we use to taste delicious ice cream!
quests.question: Mouth
quests.hint: You open and close this to talk and eat!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Mouth helps you eat, talk, and smile!
quests.funFact: Your mouth helps you talk, eat, and smile every day!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that sits on top of your neck!
quests.question: Head
quests.hint: It is the very top part of you!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Head is the part on top of your neck that holds your brain and face!
quests.funFact: Your head holds your brain, which helps you think and dream!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part we use to run and kick a soccer ball!
quests.question: Feet
quests.hint: You wear shoes and socks on these!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Feet help you stand, walk, and run!
quests.funFact: About a quarter of all the bones in your body are in your feet!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part we use to run fast in the park!
quests.question: Legs
quests.hint: You have two, and you use them to walk!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Legs help you walk, run, and jump!
quests.funFact: Your legs have the biggest, strongest bones in your whole body!

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part we count on when we learn numbers?
quests.question: Fingers
quests.hint: You use these to point and count.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Fingers help you point, count, and pick up small things!
quests.funFact: Your fingers can feel even the tiniest bump on a surface.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part we use to listen to happy music?
quests.question: Ears
quests.hint: Cover these and sounds become quiet.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Ears help you hear sounds like music and voices!
quests.funFact: Ears also help you keep your balance when you stand.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that grows on top of your head!
quests.question: Hair
quests.hint: You comb or brush this part every day!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Hair grows on top of your head and helps keep it warm!
quests.funFact: Your hair grows about half an inch every month!

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part that holds up the straps of your backpack?
quests.question: Shoulders
quests.hint: They are found where your arms begin.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Shoulders are where your arms connect to your body, and help you shrug and lift!
quests.funFact: You use your shoulders every time you carry a backpack.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part we use to wave hello and goodbye?
quests.question: Arms
quests.hint: Your hands are found at the end of these.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Arms help you hug, wave, and carry things!
quests.funFact: Your arms can stretch out wide, like airplane wings.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part we use to breathe in fresh air?
quests.question: Nose
quests.hint: You breathe air in and out through it.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Nose helps you smell and breathe in fresh air!
quests.funFact: Breathing through your nose warms the air before it reaches your lungs.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part you count when you play a counting game with your feet?
quests.question: Toes
quests.hint: They are found at the end of your feet.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Toes help you balance and push off the ground when you walk!
quests.funFact: Your big toe helps you balance more than any other toe.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part we use to catch a big bouncy ball?
quests.question: Hands
quests.hint: They are found at the end of your arms.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Hands help you hold, clap, and catch things!
quests.funFact: Your hands can feel if something is soft, rough, hot, or cold.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part that helps you taste if food is sweet or sour?
quests.question: Tongue
quests.hint: It lives inside your mouth and moves when you talk.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Tongue helps you taste your food and speak clearly!
quests.funFact: Your tongue helps you talk clearly, not just taste food.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part we brush every morning and every night?
quests.question: Teeth
quests.hint: They are hard, white, and live inside your mouth.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Teeth help you bite and chew your food!
quests.funFact: Your teeth are the hardest part of your whole body.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part we blink to keep clean and safe?
quests.question: Eyes
quests.hint: Close these and everything turns dark.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Eyes help you see everything around you, like colors and shapes!
quests.funFact: You blink your eyes thousands of times every single day.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part we open wide to sing a happy song?
quests.question: Mouth
quests.hint: Your teeth and tongue live inside it.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Mouth helps you eat, talk, and smile!
quests.funFact: You use dozens of little muscles just to smile with your mouth.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part you turn to look left and right?
quests.question: Neck
quests.hint: You turn this to look behind you.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Neck connects your head to your shoulders and lets your head turn!
quests.funFact: Giraffes have very long necks, but yours works the very same way.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part we use to stand tall and jump high?
quests.question: Feet
quests.hint: They are found at the end of your legs.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Feet help you stand, walk, and run!
quests.funFact: Your feet help you balance so you do not fall over.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part we use to jump high like a bunny?
quests.question: Legs
quests.hint: Your feet are found at the end of these.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Legs help you walk, run, and jump!
quests.funFact: You use your legs to run, jump, climb, and dance.
